gloss: novice; beginner; fledgling; just starting out

definitions.gloss: novice; beginner; fledgling; just starting out
definitions.explanation: Someone who has just entered a profession or field and is still inexperienced; a person at the beginning of their career.

examples.japanese: まだ{駆|か}け{出|だ}しの{記者|きしゃ}です。
{駆|か}け{出|だ}しの{頃|ころ}は{苦労|くろう}した。
examples.english: I struggled when I was just starting out.

examples.japanese: {駆|か}け{出|だ}しだからといって{甘|あま}く{見|み}ないでほしい。
examples.english: Don't underestimate me just because I'm a beginner.

notes:
{駆|か}け{出|だ}し describes someone who is just starting in a profession.

FORMS:
- From {駆|か}け{出|だ}す (to start running)
- Metaphor: having just "run out" into a field/profession

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駆|か}け{出|だ}しの + [profession]: novice [profession]
  - {駆|か}け{出|だ}しの{記者|きしゃ}: novice reporter
  - {駆|か}け{出|だ}しの{俳優|はいゆう}: fledgling actor
  - {駆|か}け{出|だ}しの{医者|いしゃ}: newly practicing doctor
- {駆|か}け{出|だ}しの{頃|ころ}: when just starting out

USAGE:
Implies inexperience but also suggests enthusiasm and potential for growth. Often used in self-deprecating contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {玄人|くろうと}: expert, professional
- {老練|ろうれん}: experienced, seasoned
